objective: Unattended inspection of all 25 assembly slots without requiring a teammate's D435-trained model.

vrm_inspection_scope.approved_change: 2026-09-08 user accepts fully seated placement anywhere inside socket; right-wall 1mm process clearance is not an inspection defect criterion.
vrm_inspection_scope.retained: Missing, wrong orientation, actual socket exit and lip seating; uncertain evidence stays UNKNOWN.
vrm_inspection_scope.restriction: Removing RIGHT-only nomination does not certify socket containment, height, or overall PASS.

smd01_micro_seating_scope.reason: User agreed to defer micro lip seating after unstable normal warnings and ambiguous socket wall evidence.
smd01_micro_seating_scope.retained: Raw evidence, missing, rotation, and independent position checks; no PASS promotion.
smd01_micro_seating_scope.limitation: Small height-only defects may no longer receive a displayed seating candidate. This is scope reduction, not improved detection accuracy.

hbm_pin_candidate_scope.provider: same-slot reference-relative long pin-band gap plus legacy per-pin near-absence evidence and candidate circles
hbm_pin_candidate_scope.limitations: Does not certify single-pin defects, total dark-band absence, height, or placement. Missing reference, uncertain presence or invalid alignment abstains. No candidate is not PASS.
hbm_pin_candidate_scope.validation: Developmental same-session normal and partial-loss replay only; no production authority.

preprocessing_contract.learned_provider_input: registered original S22 color pixels without CLAHE
preprocessing_contract.opencv_local_input: grayscale CLAHE clipLimit=2.0 tileGridSize=8x8, with raw grayscale corroboration only when CLAHE saturation would erase physical contrast
preprocessing_contract.restriction: No preprocessing may normalize away slot-relative position or orientation defects.

stages.purpose: Reject stale, blurred, clipped, overexposed, or badly framed captures before inspection.
Perspective-rectify the fixture and board into the fixed 1600x1266 board frame.
Determine presence, slot-relative center, and in-plane angle for every expected component.
provider_order: S22 fixed-slot state classifier (VRM: EMPTY/CORRECT/ROTATED; other types: PRESENT/EMPTY)
slot-relative geometry and independent orientation-feature checks
stages.restriction: Texture-ambiguous segmentation masks cannot independently assert PRESENT; an unvalidated slot classifier remains ADVISORY_ONLY.

stages.purpose: Confirm orientation independently from the component detector.
checks: VRM fixed-slot CORRECT versus ROTATED state

stages.purpose: Inspect GPU/HBM white pins and fine local appearance using high-resolution slot ROIs.
provider_order: explicit white-pin row and continuity check
slot-level PatchCore or FR-PatchCore appearance candidate

stages.purpose: Screen for unexpected global appearance changes that the explicit slot checks did not describe.
stages.restriction: FR-PatchCore registration must not be used to excuse component position or orientation defects.

provider_contract.low_confidence_policy: Return UNKNOWN; never convert a weak score into PASS.

fusion_policy.pass: Every required stage for every expected slot is calibrated, available, and PASS.
fusion_policy.fail: At least one calibrated authoritative stage reports a confirmed FAIL.
fusion_policy.unknown: Any required stage is missing, stale, uncalibrated, contradictory, or low-confidence.
fusion_policy.unknown_runtime_action: Automatically recapture and rerun; after the configured retry limit, hold the board or route it as NG_UNCERTAIN without an operator PASS override.
fusion_policy.model_degradation: Continue all independent stages. A degraded or unavailable model removes only its own vote and cannot make the board PASS.
fusion_policy.human_role: Dataset review and threshold validation during development only; no human visual decision in the target production loop.

data_policy.normal_training_rule: Only verified correctly assembled S22 captures may enter normal training.
forbidden_normal_variation: slot-relative component shift outside socket tolerance
allowed_normal_variation: board-level camera pose variation removed by registration
lighting variation that has been separately validated
